title: FileBackup configuration (SR-042)
description: Versioned JSON configuration contract for FileBackup.ps1 -ConfigPath. Published as documentation/editor support; the hand-rolled PowerShell validator in Modules/FileBackup.Engine.psm1 (Import-BackupConfiguration) is the runtime authority. TC-077 pins the two against one fixture corpus so this file cannot drift from the validator. CLIXML configs are the unversioned legacy native-Windows form and are not covered by this schema.

ConfigVersion.description: Currently 3 (versions 1 and 2 are refused as too old: v2 removed PreserveFolderTree — storage is always content-addressed — and added BrowseView/ViewPath; v3 replaced BackupPath and ChangePath with StorePath, one folder per backup set holding Latest/ and every Snapshot_<date>/). A config declaring a higher version is refused by this build. JSON has one number type, so an integral-valued number IS that integer: 3.0 is accepted as 3 (both by this const and by the runtime validator); 3.5, 0, "3", 1, 2 and anything above 3 are refused.

BackupSets.description: One or more backup sets. An array of at least one set object, or -- matching the runtime validator, which wraps it -- a single bare set object.

StorePath.description: One folder per backup set: it holds Latest/ (the latest state), every Snapshot_<date>/ beside it, and the run's own files. A new or empty folder starts a store; a folder holding an old-layout backup (a MANIFEST.csv of its own, or a folder beside Latest that holds one) is refused, because no store is converted.

CompressProbe.description: Optional; defaults to 'always'. How the stored form is decided when CompressEnabled is true (SR-081): 'off' uses the already-compressed extension list alone (the pre-WP17 behaviour); 'excluded-extensions' keeps the list's exemptions and measures everything it would otherwise compress; 'always' measures every file above the 256 KiB floor, the list serving only the smaller tail. Exact lowercase; optional and defaulted.

BrowseView.description: Optional; defaults to 'off'. 'index' generates a browsable, manifest-derived INDEX.tsv + per-folder HTML view outside Latest and the snapshots. 'link' is reserved and refused by name.

ViewPath.description: Optional; defaults to '<StorePath>/View'. Inside the store it may only be that one folder; elsewhere it must not overlap the store or the source, and it must be on the store's volume. Only meaningful with BrowseView 'index'.

SourceStatePath.description: Accepted for compatibility; no longer used. The latest backup MANIFEST.csv is the only change-detection record, so nothing is read from or written to this path, and a run that sets it logs a warning. Leave it out. Its one remaining effect: without it, the old source-side record's files at the source root (MANIFEST.csv, MANIFEST.csv.meta and their .tmp) are kept out of the backup; when it names a folder other than SourcePath, those files are captured as data like any other.

AllowEmptySource.description: Accepted for compatibility; ignored. It does not let an empty source through: a source that is empty while the backup holds files stops the run with 4, leaving the latest state as it was (a missing mount looks like that). A set whose source really is meant to be empty is removed from the configuration.

secrets.description: Secrets.Credential is intentionally NOT a listed property: JSON cannot carry a PSCredential, and additionalProperties:false rejects it. Containerized runs are -NoMail.
